validation.replayStore: shared durable strongly consistent store used by every Control replica
validation.atomicRule: after signature/timestamp/body validation and before any outbox or lifecycle mutation, atomically insert replayKey with accepted timestamp and expiry; unique conflict returns replay without invoking handler
validation.retention: retain until max(request timestamp + clockSkewMs + nonceTtlMs, insertion time + nonceTtlMs)
validation.concurrency: concurrent duplicates across threads/replicas have exactly one insert winner; all losers fail closed
validation.crashSemantics: a committed nonce reservation remains consumed even if the operation crashes; retry requires a newly signed nonce and relies on application operation idempotency
validation.test: deterministic barriers prove one winner, zero loser handler calls, durable restart rejection, and shared-replica conflict

originCanonicalization.input: the serialized browser Origin header as ASCII/UTF-8; exactly one origin, no list
algorithm: reject absent, empty, null, opaque origins, C0 controls, whitespace, userinfo, query, fragment, or any path other than empty or /
parse as an absolute URL using WHATWG URL semantics
scheme must be lowercase http or https after parsing; other schemes reject
host is the WHATWG ASCII host: DNS labels lowercased and IDNA ToASCII; reject invalid IDNA, empty host, and any DNS host with a trailing dot
IPv4 uses canonical dotted-decimal WHATWG serialization; IPv6 uses lowercase compressed WHATWG bracketed serialization
remove port 80 for http and 443 for https; retain every other canonical decimal port; reject invalid/out-of-range ports
output ASCII scheme://host[:port] with no trailing slash
originCanonicalization.securityRule: compare and sign only the canonical output; allowlist entries are canonicalized at startup and duplicate aliases reject configuration
